card.name: Linking words right before "two"
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "in", "every" or "of" that come just before the number "two" in phrases like "one or two", "a thing or two", "in half" and "power of two".

modes.label: "or two" phrases
modes.description: The word "or" after a small noun or "one", where "two" comes next.
modes.example: So I’m sure you’ve read a thing<< or>> two about all those crazy electronic voting machines

modes.label: Other links before two
modes.description: "every", "of" or "in" placed just before "two" or a similar small number.
modes.example: to mean either “twice each” or “every two,” a word like biweekly can be understood as “twice each week” or “<<every>> two weeks.” Confusion is often avoided

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a number word such as fifty, sixty or seventy next, and suppresses digit forms of 2 and 3.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a small number like "two", as in "a day or two".
